pool.subject: templates/chota-react-redux/src/containers/TodoListContainer.jsx
pool.title: Selector returns a new object every call
pool.comment: The container's selector (getVisibleTodos) builds a new object on every call, so the todo list re-renders on every store update even when it did not change: three theme toggles cause three re-renders (measured with React 19.2.5 and React-Redux 9.2.0). shallowEqual only hides it on the All filter. Make the selector memoized (createSelector) so it returns the same reference when its inputs are unchanged, and keep the template consistent with the other templates and the state-selectors skill.

pool.subject: docs/courses/state-layer/selectors.md
pool.title: Reselect cache described wrongly
pool.comment: The lesson says Reselect's cache holds only the last call. In Reselect 5 (used by Redux Toolkit 2) the default memoize is weakMapMemoize, which keeps an entry per set of arguments; the single-entry lruMemoize is an option. Correct the lesson and cite the Reselect 5 docs.

pool.subject: docs/practice/memoized-selector.md
pool.title: Reselect cache described wrongly
pool.comment: The question's explanation says Reselect's cache holds only the last call. In Reselect 5 the default memoize (weakMapMemoize) keeps an entry per set of arguments; lruMemoize with maxSize 1 is the old behaviour. Correct the explanation without changing the question's tests.
